tree: Keep track of calls, emails, messages, meetings and next steps with a simple, organized reminder system.

tree.aria-label: Noxtill follow-up workflow: quote sent, wait two days, check reply, then send reminder email, create a call task and notify the owner

tree: How can a CRM automate customer follow ups?
CRM follow up automation sets a reminder or sends a message after a set time, so every quote, call and meeting gets a next step without anyone keeping a list.
Follow-ups live in notebooks and memory, so warm customers go cold.
Noxtill reminds the right person, or sends the follow-up itself, right on time.
Each follow-up has an owner and a time.
Get a clear view of your upcoming, overdue and completed follow-ups — so you can focus on what matters most.
Call to discuss project requirements and next steps.
Set it once. Let Noxtill handle the rest.
Create simple rules to automatically create follow-ups based on customer activity, deal stage or specific events.
Automatically create follow-ups for key events so nothing falls through the cracks.
Choose how and when you want to be notified about your upcoming follow-ups.
Whether you run a local business, a service company or a sales team, Noxtill Follow-ups & Reminders helps you stay organized and responsive.
